Fonts:      Liberation Sans/Serif/Mono, Regular/Bold/Italic/BoldItalic (12 files)
Source:     https://github.com/liberationfonts/liberation-fonts (upstream project;
            installed here via Homebrew Cask `font-liberation` 2.1.5)
Downloaded: 2026-08-02
Verified:   License and copyright confirmed two ways before adding to this repo:
            (1) the bundled LICENSE file (this directory), and (2) the name-table
            strings embedded directly in each .ttf itself ("Licensed under the SIL
            Open Font License, Version 1.1", "Copyright (c) 2012 Red Hat, Inc." /
            "Digitized data copyright (c) 2010 Google Corporation") — checked via
            `strings LiberationSans-Regular.ttf | grep -i license`, not assumed.

License:    SIL Open Font License 1.1 (see LICENSE.txt in this directory). OFL
            explicitly permits bundling/embedding the fonts with software and
            states the license does not carry over to documents created using
            the fonts — i.e. a PDF a user converts with these fonts embedded is
            not itself OFL-encumbered.

Used by:    js/pdfaFontSubstitute.js — optional, opt-in substitution for
            unembedded standard-14 PDF fonts (Helvetica/Arial, Times/Times New
            Roman, Courier/Courier New families only) during PDF/A conversion.
            Liberation Sans/Serif/Mono are metric-compatible replacements for
            Arial/Times New Roman/Courier New by design (that is the explicit
            purpose of the Liberation project) — but see pdfaFontSubstitute.js
            for the actual width-table verification done before ever using
            them, rather than trusting metric-compatibility as a given.
